title: Validate completed manifest apply
summary: Added confirmed-apply fixture coverage for completed manifest reconciliation and corrected the completed manifest dry-run operator guidance to point at the available confirmed apply route.
reason: Repair/reconcile validation had coverage for sidecar, pending manifest, orphan payload, fingerprint rejection, strict payload validation, and journaling, but not the completed manifest reconciliation apply branch itself.
behavior_before: The completed manifest reconciliation apply route existed but lacked a focused confirmed-apply test proving a selected backend dry-run candidate rewrites only the completed manifest with a backup while preserving source, output, and sidecar files. The dry-run candidate guidance still said no completed manifest write route existed.
behavior_after: The apply suite now covers completed manifest reconciliation with strict dry-run fingerprint flow, manifest backup/write evidence, selected row scope, and source/output/sidecar preservation. Completed manifest dry-run candidate guidance now directs operators to the matching confirmed apply route.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet, the completed manifest dry-run guidance string change, the added apply test coverage, and the regenerated summaries.
notes:
Update completed manifest dry-run guidance to point at the available confirmed apply route.
Add confirmed apply coverage for completed manifest reconciliation preserving source/output/sidecar state.
Refresh generated summaries for the changed repair/reconcile dry-run and apply-test files.
Refresh dependency graph for the new test import edge.
